Personality: The Weeper is cruel and vengeful, and is good at using surprise and torture to make enemies afraid to pursue. He does not seek the recognition of the southern knights, but only cares whether his tribe will follow out of fear and loot.
Background: The Weeper is the leader of the free people outside the Great Wall and has been active north of the Great Wall for a long time. He has a blood feud with the Night's Watch, and his fame comes primarily from ambushes, throat-slitting, and cruelty to his captives.
